fact.en: Lin, 23:02: "Don't trust the me who's talking."

limit.en: A voice alone doesn't verify who sent it.
limit.zh: 单靠声音不能确认身份。

fact.en: The center feed plays the same cup push twice. Same motion, same sound.
fact.zh: 中心转播把同一个推杯动作播了两遍，动作和声音完全相同。

limit.en: It shows the feed isn't live. Not who did it.
limit.zh: 只能说明转播不是实时的，不能说明是谁干的。

fact.en: Lin answered a move you just made up, on the direct line. The center feed did not.
fact.zh: 你临时提的动作，Lin 在直连上做到了；中心转播没有回应。

limit.en: This line is live. It doesn't prove she's hiding nothing.
limit.zh: 说明这条线是实时的，不说明她没有隐瞒。

fact.en: Center feed source: CLIP-A17, recorded at last night's shift handover. Not camera B2-03.
fact.zh: 中心转播来源：素材 CLIP-A17，昨晚交班时录制，不是 B2-03 摄像头。

limit.en: Shows what played. Not who pressed play.
limit.zh: 说明播的是什么，不说明谁按的播放。

fact.en: 23:17 manual lockdown, B2. User shown: L-YAO.
fact.zh: 23:17，B2 手动闭锁，显示工号 L-YAO。

limit.en: A display name is not the person who did it.
limit.zh: 显示名不等于实际操作人。

fact.en: Full entry: session MIG-0412, delegated. Started from an operations account.
fact.zh: 完整条目：会话 MIG-0412，委托会话，由运维账号发起。

limit.en: A photo of a screen, not the raw log. It does not name a person.
limit.zh: 是屏幕照片，不是底层日志，也没有写是哪个人。

fact.en: Chen: "The relay only streams live. It can't replay anything." He asked you to switch off auto-backup.
fact.zh: Chen 说：“转播只能直播，不能回放。”并要你关掉自动备份。

limit.en: A claim, until something contradicts it.
limit.zh: 在有矛盾证据之前，这只是一个说法。

fact.en: The man in the coverall opened the stair door with a spare key and let Lin through.
fact.zh: 穿工装的男人用备用钥匙打开楼梯门，让 Lin 过去。

limit.en: He helped once. That doesn't explain why he's here.
limit.zh: 他帮了一次，不说明他为什么在这里。

fact.en: Lin admits she already copied the original fire record to a USB stick. She kept it from you.
fact.zh: Lin 承认她已把火灾原始记录复制到 U 盘，一直瞒着你。

limit.en: A copy needs a witness or a second source.
limit.zh: 副本还需要证人或第二来源。

fact.en: Six years ago, fire in Vault B3. Night worker Wei Han died. The sprinkler valve was logged as open; the valve itself says otherwise.
fact.zh: 六年前地下三层起火，夜班工人 Wei Han 死亡。日志写喷淋阀门已打开，阀门本身的状态对不上。

limit.en: Shows the log was wrong. Not yet who changed it.
limit.zh: 说明日志有假，还不能说明是谁改的。

fact.en: Xu saw the valve closed that night and saw the log entry change. He stayed silent for six years.
fact.zh: Xu 当晚看到阀门是关的，也看到日志后来被改。他沉默了六年。

limit.en: One witness. He has to be willing to say it.
limit.zh: 只是一个证人，他得愿意说出来。

fact.en: Your new move appeared only on the direct line. The relay kept showing the old reaction, and Chen answered to the old one.
fact.zh: 你设计的新动作只出现在直连上；转播继续放旧反应，Chen 按旧反应回答了你。

limit.en: Shows he is watching the relay, and believes it.
limit.zh: 说明他在看转播，并且相信它。

fact.en: CLIP-A17 and session MIG-0412 were both started from console C-2, on Chen Cen's badge.
fact.zh: CLIP-A17 和会话 MIG-0412 都从控制台 C-2 发起，用的是 Chen Cen 的工卡。

limit.en: This is the chain. It names him.
limit.zh: 这是完整操作链，指向他本人。
